title: VDE VM Type Configuration
description: Schema for VDE VM type static configuration. Defines VM types with SSH ports for Docker host access and service ports for infrastructure VMs.

description.description: Optional description of this configuration file

vms.description: VM type definitions organized by category

languageVM.description: Development language VM configuration. Container name: {name}-dev, SSH port: static assignment 2200-2399.

name.description: VM identifier (lowercase alphanumeric). Used for container naming, SSH config, directories.

pkgs.description: Shell command for container provisioning (runs as root)

custom_cmd.description: Custom shell command for non-apt installations (curl, git, etc.)

service_ports.description: Must be null for language VMs (no service ports)

ssh_port.description: SSH port on Docker host (2200-2399 for language VMs)

serviceVM.description: Infrastructure service VM configuration. Container name: {name}, SSH port: static assignment 2400-2499, service ports: defined here.

name.description: VM identifier (lowercase alphanumeric). Used for container naming, SSH config, directories.

pkgs.description: Shell command for container provisioning (runs as root)

custom_cmd.description: Custom shell command for non-apt installations (curl, git, etc.)

service_ports.description: Service port(s) to expose (comma-separated integers: '80' or '80,443')

ssh_port.description: SSH port on Docker host (2400-2499 for service VMs)
